statements: Customers paste links into comments and we show a preview. Add preview(url, deps) in src/preview.mjs. It returns { url, status, title }, where title is the page's <title> text, or null if it has none, and url is the final address.

deps.resolve(hostname) returns a list of IP addresses. deps.connect(address, url) connects to that exact address and returns { status, headers, body }, with lowercase header names. deps.resolve is the only way to look up a name, and deps.connect is the only way to reach anything.
Follow redirects, at most 5, and resolve each new address. Only http and https links are allowed.

This runs inside our network, so a preview must never connect to anything that is not on the public internet. Anything else is refused by throwing HttpError 400 with code forbidden_url, without connecting to it. Addresses on the public internet must keep working, for IPv4 and IPv6.
brief: Add the link preview described in the ticket, safely for a server inside our network.
